races.title: Bangor-On-Dee 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: STARMOUNT jumped really well when dominating 2 Wetherby novice hurdles from the front last season and he can make a winning chase debut at the chief expense of Le Beau Madrik , who clearly benefited from his initial chase experience at Wetherby last time. STARMOUNT (IRE) LE BEAU MADRIK (FR) FIERCELY PROUD (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Starmount (11/8), Count Of Vendome (10/3), Le Beau Madrik (10/3), Fiercely Proud (4/1)

races.title: Boat At Erbistock Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: AIR APPARENT appeals as a potentially useful sort in this sphere and he's hard to oppose able to race unpenalised for last week's Carlisle success. Kartoon And Co showed plenty to work on despite a near 3-year absence on his chase debut and can improve on that effort, with Ffos Las winner Gustapof completing the shortlist. AIR APPARENT (IRE) KARTOON AND CO (FR) GUSTAPOF (FR)

races.title: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A competitive affair but HARD DEALT makes plenty of appeal just 4 days on from making a winning chase debut at Warwick, a quick turnaround only a minor concern given the ease of that success. Dig Deep should make a superior chaser to a hurdler and rates as an interesting chase newcomer, with Perth winner Berkenshtaaap also considered in his hat-trick bid. HARD DEALT (IRE) DIG DEEP (IRE) BERKENSHTAAAP (IRE)

races.title: Wrexham Lager Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Those with chase experience look of most interest here, with ESCORT'KHEOPS chief amongst them after his third here last month. Crystello will be suited by the return to 3m and rates as a potential improver, with Knead A Win also meriting respect on his chase bow. ESCORT'KHEOPS (FR) CRYSTELLO (IRE) KNEAD A WIN (FR)

races.title: Outerspace Group 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JETZET made a promising start over hurdles at Southwell 3 weeks ago, looking sure to be suited by this longer trip, and he gets the vote. Grande J was a 16-length winner of a point in Ireland in February and makes plenty of appeal, with Hunting Call another to note. JETZET (IRE) GRANDE J (IRE) HUNTING CALL (IRE)

races.title: Mount Vines Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MILLE ET UNE VIES was Grade 3-placed in France and, while slightly disappointing at Cheltenham in March after 10 months off, this is a much softer assignment and she is likely to prove hard to beat, with Aeropress feared most after a promising hurdles debut at Worcester and Perfect Package a newcomer to note from an in-form yard. MILLE ET UNE VIES (FR) AEROPRESS (IRE) PERFECT PACKAGE (FR)
